findings.claim: The new Troubleshooting row for 'No interactions wanted here' in task8ShowsThatAPlainMockIsOnlyCalledWhenYouPassItIn gives two examples that do not produce that message. Critic runs at b5b542a7 on a private completed solution with one Task 8 step 3 change each: (a) built from the context's @MockitoBean, create called through built, learner verify on the plain mock: fails with Mockito's 'Wanted but not invoked'; (b) the same but verifying on the context mock: fails with the shipped 'step 3: call create on the controller you built, with POSTED'; (c) built on the plain mock but the create call sent as a MockMvc request instead of through built, learner verify on the plain mock: fails with 'Wanted but not invoked'. Among the variants I ran, the message appeared (grep of each run's output for the literal 'No interactions wanted here') only (d) when the learner's verify on the plain mock is missing (first clause of the row, correct) or (e) when the complete plain-mock path is done and an extra MockMvc request also reaches the context mock. So 'a controller built with the context's mock' never leads here, and 'instead of the plain mock' is wrong for MockMvc; the accurate cause is 'in addition to'. The learner is still routed to step 3, so the impact is low.
findings.recommendation: Reword the second clause to the case that produces the message, for example: 'or something else also called the context's @MockitoBean during this test (for example an extra request through MockMvc); step 3 must leave the context mock untouched'. Drop 'a controller built with the context's mock' from this row; that case already matches the 'Wanted but not invoked' row.

findings.claim: A learner who adds Spring's class-level @Validated to the controller for Task 5 step 3 gets errors with no README guidance. The Spring Framework reference (Validation, evidence below) states that a class-level @Validated applies method validation through an AOP proxy and must be removed to use Spring MVC's built-in method validation. Critic run at b5b542a7 on a private completed solution plus a class-level @Validated on BookingController (constraint unchanged): task5ReproducesTheZeroIdReport, task5PredictsTheProblemBodyOfTheFix and task5RejectsANonPositiveIdWith400 all end in errors (not assertion failures): MockMvc throws a jakarta.servlet.ServletException 'Request processing failed' caused by jakarta.validation.ConstraintViolationException 'byId.id: must be greater than 0', while the README says only 'no @Valid is needed here' and Troubleshooting has no row for this stack trace. The six module pages do not mention @Validated, so the README is the only place that can catch it. Low: the hint names the right constraint and placement, and the learner sees a clear exception name.

evidence.section: Web on Servlet Stack > Annotated Controllers > Validation (paragraph on class-level @Validated and method validation)

findings.recommendation: In Task 5 step 3 add 'and no @Validated on the class', and add a Troubleshooting row: 'Request processing failed ... ConstraintViolationException in the Task 5 tests: the controller class carries @Validated, which switches to the older proxy-based validation; remove it so Spring MVC's built-in method validation answers the 400'.

findings.claim: The optional spot check tells the learner to run 'mvn -q -o spring-boot:run' from starter/, and loop 7 now sends the learner there to compare the GET /bookings/0 body with the Task 5 prediction (lines 21-23). Critic run at b5b542a7 on a private completed solution, offline, against the copied local repository supplied for this review (I did not re-run the setup command myself): the command fails at once with 'No plugin found for prefix 'spring-boot' in the current project and in the plugin groups'. The starter pom declares no spring-boot-maven-plugin in its build plugins; by inference from the pom (not run), mvn -q dependency:go-offline therefore does not fetch it, which matches the author's reported failure. A git grep at b5b542a7 finds no Spring Boot lab pom on this branch that declares it. README's Offline note ('Only the setup step uses the network. No database and no port are used.') also does not mention that the spot check opens port 8080. This predates loop 7 (main-era wording, noted by the author as out of loop-7 scope); it is optional and the tests remain the gate, so low. The README's own print route for Task 5 works (see the cg-education-validation-011 recheck).
findings.recommendation: In this module's branch, either declare org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-maven-plugin in starter/pom.xml build plugins (so setup fetches it and the -o spot check runs), or drop -o from the spot-check command and say it needs the network once, or remove the spot check and point to the Task 5 print route. Mention the port in the Offline note if the spot check stays. The same pattern in other Spring Boot labs is a separate scope.

findings.claim: web-layer-tests-with-mockmvc#o1 ('Write a @WebMvcTest that performs a request with MockMvc and asserts the status, headers and JSON body') is claimed, but in the two @WebMvcTest files neither the learner-written requests (Task 7 steps 3 and 4) nor the shipped checks around them assert any response header; Task 4's request and expectations are shipped, not written by the learner. The only content-type assertions are in ValidationApiTest and BugReportTest, which are full @SpringBootTest classes, and the learner-edited BugReportTest checks no header in learner-written code. So the headers part of this compound objective is never practised. The claim predates this branch (present in origin/main lab.json), so this is the same class as cg-education-validation-014: an inconsistency with the problemdetail#o2 standard, not a loop-7 regression. Read only (git grep of the four test files for header and contentType expectations).
findings.recommendation: Cheapest executable fix in a later module branch: in Task 7 step 3 ask the learner to also expect the problem+json content type, and add a shipped check on result.getResponse().getContentType(). Otherwise, record partial lab coverage for this objective in module.json sourceCoverageNotes, together with the three objectives of cg-education-validation-014.
